subject: Acuvera Health - double metering on connector usage / remediation plan
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acuvera.health>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@acuvera.health
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: Unexpected spike / double charge on connector ingest - please advise

Hi Marissa,

Hope you’re well — we noticed a large unexpected spike on our November usage. After digging in our logs and comparing connector-level metrics, it looks like the Acuvera connector was double-counted across two ingestion workers between 2026-11-02 and 2026-11-04. The attached export shows duplicate entries (rows with identical request ids).

Total impact on our invoice: approx €8,430 (net). We need guidance on how Redwood will remediate. We’re aiming for:
- Confirmation this was an overcount/bug on Redwood’s side
- A service credit or invoice adjustment for the overbilled amount
- Any VAT/evidence required for our AP team to accept the revised invoice

Can you please advise next steps and an ETA for a credit?

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Data Platforms
Acuvera Health

[attachment: acuvera-usage-report-Nov-2026.csv (CSV, 42KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acuvera.health>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 12:28:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike / double charge on connector ingest - please advise

Hi Elena — thanks for the report and the CSV, that’s exactly the detail we need. I’m escalating to Finance and Billing to validate the usage rows and calculate the correct credit.

Internal plan (quick):
- David / Kim to validate the duplicate request ids and confirm that the duplicate rows were ingested twice by our metering pipeline.
- If confirmed, we’ll issue a provisional goodwill credit (covers customer impact while we finalize official adjustments) and reissue an adjusted invoice.
- We’ll include VAT handling guidance for Acuvera’s AP team — since you’re in the EU we’ll include reverse-charge proof if applicable.

David / Kim / Rishi — can you prioritize this and reply with an estimate for validation and proposed credit amount? I’ll send a customer-facing remediation note once we have numbers.

Elena — expected turnaround: 3 business days for validation, plus 2 more for issuing adjusted invoice & credit memo. If you need it faster, let me know and I’ll request an expedited approval from Finance.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0176

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acuvera.health>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 15:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike / double charge on connector ingest - please advise

Hi all — I validated the attached export and our internal metering logs. Summary:
- Metering pipeline generated duplicate meter events for connector_acuvera between 2026-11-02 03:00Z and 2026-11-04 11:45Z due to a race condition during a rolling worker restart.
- Duplicate tokenized rows = 58,432 tokens double-counted.
- Gross overcharge (before VAT): €7,850. VAT on original invoice = 7% (local Acuvera VAT profile) => VAT portion on the overcharge = €549.50.

Proposal:
1) Immediate provisional goodwill credit: €8,400 (rounding up to include estimated VAT and goodwill buffer). This will be applied to your account balance within 24 hours and visible in the console.
2) Formal adjusted invoice and credit memo: we will reissue an invoice and a PDF credit memo reflecting the corrected usage and VAT handling. Expected delivery: by 2026-11-19 EOD.
3) Evidence for reverse-charge/VAT: if Acuvera requires a reverse-charge statement or tax residency certificate, please attach that to this thread or upload to the Drive link below.
4) If procurement requires a signed adjustment, we can route via DocuSign (link provided).

Attachments: I’m attaching the calculation worksheet used to compute the credit and a draft credit memo (proposed-credit-memo-ACV-9342.pdf).

Kim / Rishi: I need a quick approval for the provisional goodwill amount (we are intentionally rounding to expedite). If ok, Marissa will communicate to the customer and I’ll schedule the formal invoice reissue.

Thanks,
David Kim
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

[attachment: proposed-credit-memo-ACV-9342.pdf (PDF, 16KB)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@acuvera.health>, procurement@acuvera.health
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 16:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike / double charge on connector ingest - remediation and next steps

Hi Elena / Acuvera AP team — quick update and actions we’re taking: 

1) Provisional goodwill credit: We’ve applied a provisional credit of €8,400 to Acuvera’s account. You should see this reflected in the Redwood Console under Billing > Credits within 24 hours. This is to make you whole while we finalize the formal paperwork.

2) Formal documents: Attached are the adjusted invoice (adjusted-invoice-ACV-9342-202611.pdf) and the official credit memo (proposed-credit-memo-ACV-9342.pdf). The adjusted invoice reduces net usage by €7,850 and adjusts the VAT line accordingly.

3) VAT / reverse-charge: To finalize the VAT handling, please confirm which of the following Acuvera can provide:
   - VAT registration number and proof of EU tax residency (certificate of VAT registration)
   - If reverse-charge applies in your jurisdiction, a signed statement from your AP team requesting reverse-charge treatment for this adjusted invoice

4) Procurement / signed adjustments: If your procurement team requires a signed adjustment, reply and we’ll send a DocuSign link.

5) Root cause & mitigation: Engineering fixed the metering race condition that caused the duplication; we’ve deployed a guard so the same duplication window can’t recur. Full postmortem will be posted to the shared Drive link below by next week.

Links & attachments:
- Drive evidence: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/acuvera/billing/evidence-ACV-9342
- HubSpot deal: https://redwood.app/hubspot/deal/ACV-9342
- Attachments: adjusted-invoice-ACV-9342-202611.pdf, proposed-credit-memo-ACV-9342.pdf

Elena — please confirm receipt and whether Acuvera can provide the VAT residency doc. Happy to hop on a 15-min call if that helps your AP team reconcile faster.

Best regards,
Marissa Cole
Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0176
